messages.en:
{07 00 00}I really want to thank you.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 1b 00}But {01 00 00 05 00}you can't{01 00 00 05 00} carry any
more stuff!
Lighten your load and come
on back, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma tahan sind väga tänada.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 1b 00}Aga {01 00 00 05 00}sa ei jaksa{01 00 00 05 00} rohkem
kraami kanda!
Kergenda koormat ja tule
tagasi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 1d 00}Oh, yeah, {01 00 00 05 00}I was going to
thank you for the {ff 00 00 07}medicine{ff 00 00 00},
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 19 00}Yeah, right! {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 14 00}Here, let me 
give you something,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 19 00}Jah, muidugi! {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 14 00}Säh, las ma 
annan sulle midagi,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Whaaat?!{01 00 00 05 00} You still have too
much stuff.

{07 06 00}Dude,{01 00 00 05 00} just chuck some fruit
or something, then it'll be
all good, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Miiis?!{01 00 00 05 00} Sul on ikka liiga
palju kraami.

{07 06 00}Semu,{01 00 00 05 00} viska mõni puuvili
või midagi ära, siis on
kõik hästi, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
